description: MIROC7-ILS is the land component of MIROC7. It combines the MATSIRO land-surface model (Takata et al., 2003) and the CaMa-Flood river and floodplain model within the Integrated Land Simulator framework (Nitta et al., 2020). MATSIRO retains the land-surface physical parameterizations used in MIROC6 (Tatebe et al., 2019; MATSIRO6 Document Writing Team, 2021), representing surface energy and water exchanges, canopy interception and transpiration, soil heat and moisture transport with liquid and frozen water, snow, and lake processes. CaMa-Flood routes runoff from MATSIRO and represents river storage and floodplain inundation (Yamazaki et al., 2011, 2013). A CaMa-derived lake-inflow quantity is returned to MATSIRO and used by its lake model. In the river-bearing domain, MATSIRO and CaMa-Flood operate on the same unit-catchment grid and exchange fields without spatial remapping or aggregation between the two models. MATSIRO additionally represents non-river land elements to maintain consistency with the ocean model's land-sea mask. Land variables submitted to CMIP are remapped during post-processing to a regular 0.5-degree latitude-longitude grid. Relative to the MIROC6 land configuration, changes include spatial resolution, basin-oriented grid representation, field-exchange timing, and the replacement of TRIP river routing with CaMa-Flood.
